prompts.name: 长日重启
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original full-screen background for a desktop narrative life strategy game, wide 16:9 composition.
Primary request: Original premium semi-realistic painterly cinematic game scene, a modest lived-in rented apartment in an ordinary Chinese city on the winter morning of January 1, 2020. The room should tell the hopeful story of starting life again, not a productivity app or futuristic command center.
Scene: eye-level wide lens from the room entrance, desk with an open unbranded 2019 laptop and warm desk lamp at 62% horizontal / 65% vertical, rain-streaked large window at right 85% / 42% showing layered Chinese apartment buildings at blue dawn, narrow entry door at 40% / 40%, well-used bookshelf at 20% / 45%, unmade small bed at lower left. Everyday books, ceramic cup, trailing power cable, a potted plant, worn wood and plaster. One small adult player figure in an ordinary gray sweater seated with back to camera at desk, face unseen; no celebrity identity.
Style: hand-painted narrative adventure game environment, realistic scale with expressive brushwork, carefully directed warm amber practical light against soft teal-blue city dawn, atmospheric depth, human and intimate, high art direction quality. Keep details readable, avoid excessive gritty clutter.
Composition: visually rich scene occupying entire image, objects spatially distinct and suitable for hotspot overlay. Leave the bottom 18% relatively dark and quiet for editable in-game dialogue; upper 14% low visual contrast for compact editable HUD. All interface and labels added later in code.
Constraints: original art, no existing game characters or brand assets, no text, no logos, no numbers, no UI, no dashboards, no panels, no collage, no watermark.

prompts.name: 街区人生
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide 16:9 game environment background for a fixed-camera 2.5D isometric Chinese city life and business strategy game.
Primary request: A beautifully crafted isometric urban neighborhood diorama in an ordinary Chinese city in January 2020, a place a player can explore and gradually build a life. A warm, believable living game world, not a software workspace.
Scene: a coherent small city block at clear isometric three-quarter overhead angle, with a cutaway tiny rented apartment upper left at 30% horizontal/38% vertical showing humble bed and laptop desk, open-front neighborhood cafe at 67%/42% with tables and counter, small office building upper right at 83%/28%, neighborhood grocery lower right at 75%/65%, residential lane connecting them. A few ordinary adult pedestrians and parked bicycles, potted plants and weathered air-conditioning units, no identifiable brands. Chinese mid-rise apartments in background, winter trees, a distant skyline.
Style: premium stylized 3D rendered miniature with crisp architectural forms, rich tactile materials, warm cream plaster, brick red, sage green and muted blue, inviting realistic proportions, ambient occlusion and soft winter sunlight, detailed but legible at game scale. Camera orthographic-like, actual coherent isometric layout, no floating disconnected cards.
Composition: complete traversable-looking district in central 80%, safe breathing room at top 12% for a compact HUD and bottom 15% for an editable location/action strip. Subtle darker edge framing, avoid clutter at margins. All UI will be added with HTML.
Constraints: original assets only, no text or fake lettering anywhere, blank shop signs, no logos, no UI, no financial charts, no watermark, no competitor characters, no fantasy or cyberpunk motifs.

prompts.name: 像素旧时光
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original full-screen wide 16:9 pixel-art environment for a Chinese slice-of-life narrative RPG and wealth strategy game.
Primary request: Highly art-directed, detailed 2D side-view pixel-art neighborhood in a Chinese city on the first winter evening of 2020. The emotional quality of an indie narrative RPG, warm nostalgia and a new beginning. Clearly visible deliberate square pixel clusters and limited color ramps; authentic pixel art, not blurry paint or vector art.
Scene: coherent horizontal street-level cross-section, left 38% shows a cutaway tiny rented room with bed, lamp and laptop desk at 25% horizontal/58% vertical, doorway near 40%/60%, right half an atmospheric residential street with a small cafe at 68%/52%, bus stop at 86%/55%, bicycles and one modest convenience store. Apartment balconies, bundled overhead cables, several potted plants. Two small ordinary adult NPC pixel figures near cafe, a single adult player sprite in a muted navy jacket near apartment doorway, human scale consistent.
Style: premium 16-bit-inspired narrative pixel art, carefully controlled teal shadows, burnt orange window glow, dusty rose sky, warm light reflecting off a lightly wet street. Sharp readable silhouettes, expressive city details, original cozy yet thoughtful mood. No exaggerated cartoon heads, no chibi, no farming or medieval elements.
Composition: horizontal walkable-looking foreground at 72% height; upper 15% quiet deep dusk sky for editable date and compact HUD; bottom 18% dark quiet pavement for editable RPG dialogue box. Scene objects should be distinct for click-hotspots. No baked interface.
Constraints: no readable text, no labels, no numbers, blank shop signs, no UI, no logos, no charts, no borders, no watermark, no existing game assets or characters.
